openQuestions.text: Short Rail is mapped to the existing hinge-joint short rails; Long Rail is drawn on the boom side of the hinge joint. Which pieces do the workbook rows mean?
Left/Right Rest Plate and Base Plate are drawn under the hinge-joint rails (rest = boom side, base = girder side). Please confirm their actual location.

Trolley wheels/bearings and headblock sheaves use the catenary-wheel corner order (1 back gate house, 2 front gate house, 3 front SAGT, 4 back SAGT); trolley sheaves (i)/(ii) = landside/seaside shaft; TLS cylinders 01-04 from the gate house end. Please confirm.
The Anti creeper oil row is placed at the seaside gate-house corner sill beam (rail clamp / anti-creep hydraulics). Please confirm the unit.
